integrity: Exact formulas, sign polynomials, standalone executable checker and coefficient certificate are bundled; independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem only classifies unconditional entrywise positivity for dimensions 1 through 5 and gives a single explicit negative six-cube entry. No full six-cube positivity-window classification or higher-dimensional classification is claimed. The certificate relies on exact symbolic rational arithmetic.
title: A five-dimensional positivity frontier for cubic inverse-Taylor heat stepping on Boolean cubes
